fishing: WHEN: Sun Nov 22 very good solunar (86/100), major 9:19-11:19a & 9:47-11:47p; winds N 1-10 mph, air 66-76F, water ~74F. PASSES-BEACH: Spanish mackerel, jacks, blue runners, flounder, snook, small ladyfish at Boca Grande / Stump Pass / Blind Pass / Englewood Beach / Manasota; live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: trout to 18", redfish, snook, baby gags, Spanish/ladyfish/bluefish along ICW and Stump Pass. NEARSHORE: mixed on light seas (1-2 ft). Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, paddletails, weedless spoons, pinfish. Sources: Fishin Franks Nov 20, FL Sportsman SW / Capt. Mike.
redtide: FWC Nov 20: K. brevis very low in one Charlotte County sample in SWFL. Bloom concentrations only in NWFL (Bay/Gulf). No bloom near Englewood/Manasota. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next update Nov 24.
bacteria: Sarasota/Charlotte Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key Beach GOOD (10 CFU/100mL Nov 16). Englewood Beach / Manasota Key GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2 / Sarasota ~148-149 minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
